title: Young Adults Now Cohabit More Than They Marry
hook: For the youngest adults, living together has overtaken living with a spouse.
closing: Cohabitation is no longer a short detour; it is reshaping adult partnership.
question: Would you live together first?

segments.say: Nine percent of young adults live with an unmarried partner, versus fewer with a spouse. Cohabitation now leads.
Among adults aged 25 to 34, marriage fell to 40 percent. The shift continues into the next life stage.
Cohabiting adults over 50 reached about 4.2 million. The change is spreading beyond the young.
